title: test_autopilot_bound counts every live threading.Timer, so a cancelled deadline timer or another test's timer fails a land gate
goal: autopilot.supervise joins its deadline Timer after cancelling it (timer.join with a short bound), and test_autopilot_bound checks only the timers its own run started (not a process-wide threading.enumerate), so the test no longer fails under load or beside another test's timer; a test named supervise_joins_deadline_timer plants a slow-to-exit timer. Found by BG-toq44n2c's land gate: 3785 passed, 1 failed on the within-deadline test at line 150. It can fail any runner's land.
repro_reason: the failure is a race: a cancelled timer thread is still alive when the test counts threads under load; the text match shows supervise does not join the timer after cancelling it
